verdicts.rationale: par%dy is a length in params.def and grid construction, with no upstream squaring. In the ny<=2 wet-cell viscosity path it is combined directly with squared mdx; the final MIN with other limits can mask the effect in some runs but does not correct the erroneous candidate stability limit.

Ordinary cold and hot starts set par%t=0 in timestep_init, and both t<=0 compute_dt branches explicitly set dtref=0 before testing it (timestep.F90:L462-L476). The residual defect requires starting timestep through the library after setting time positive, which the introspection/BMI setters permit; it is not an uninitialized first-step failure of the normal driver.

verdicts.rationale: Schedule files are stored in input order and no sorting or monotonicity check follows. For times [0,2,1,3], MINVAL can select 1 while the category counter expects 2, and after 2 the counter remains waiting for the past 1, suppressing subsequent outputs.

Neither the timepars component declarations nor any other initialization assigns ith/outputh. outputtimes_update reads ith when hotstart times exist and always includes outputh in the aggregate and counter update, so schedule-size checks do not eliminate the undefined-state use.

The update routine advances each category only once and excludes all current-time duplicates from the next-time minimum. A file schedule [0,1,1,2] leaves its counter expecting the second 1 after time advances, preventing output at 2; this stalls the category, not necessarily the simulation's time loop.

The groundwater branches divide by par%kx and, for the alongshore branch, par%ky; their positive minima in params.F90:L829-L835 are advisory. gw_init copies these values to local permeability fields rather than validating or repairing the parameter divisors, so zero/negative inputs can reach the stated arithmetic.
